nocturnal data is unchanged

```{r}
#| label: setup-env
pacman::p_load(data.table, tidyverse, here, glmmTMB)

here::i_am("scripts/L3/308_summary_stats.qmd")
```

# Read data


```{r}
#| label: read-data
dir_304_final_data <- here("data", "L3", "304_final_data")
dir_308_check <- here("data", "L3", "308_precip_check")

diurn_on_50 <- readRDS(here(dir_304_final_data, "304d_diurn_on_final_50.rds"))
diurn_ev_50 <- readRDS(here(dir_304_final_data, "304e_diurn_ev_final_50.rds"))
noc_50 <- readRDS(here(dir_304_final_data, "304f_noc_final_50.rds"))
```



# unfiltered data

```{r}
#| label: raw-data
# Total vocs before downstream filtering

## onset
load(here("data", "L2", "final_diurnal_first_onset.RData"))
nrow(final_diurnal_first_onset) # 9,577,620 #### 977,256

## ev cessation
load(here("data", "L2", "final_diurnal_ev_ces.RData"))
nrow(final_diurnal_ev_ces) # 7,187,860 #### 375,886

# ncotrnal
load(here("data", "L2", "final_nocturnal.RData"))
nrow(final_nocturnal |> filter(det == 1)) # 3,697,109


### Grab continents/countries
pacman::p_load(sf, rnaturalearth)

on_coords <- final_diurnal_first_onset |>
  distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)
ev_coords <- final_diurnal_ev_ces |> distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)
noc_coords <- final_nocturnal |> distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)

all_coords <- rbind(on_coords, ev_coords, noc_coords) |>
  distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)

coords_sf <- st_as_sf(
  all_coords,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)
# Lay over a map of countries to extract # of countries
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Spatial join stations with country polygons
stations_with_geo <- st_join(coords_sf, world |> select(admin, continent))

# Count total countries and continents
geo_summary <- stations_with_geo |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarize(
    total_stations = n_distinct(station_id), # 6,436 stations #### 6,451
    total_countries = n_distinct(admin, na.rm = TRUE), # 87 countries #### 88 counties
    total_continents = n_distinct(continent, na.rm = TRUE) # 6 continents #### 6 continents
  )

print(geo_summary)
```

# final model data

```{r}
#| label: total-vocs
### Total vocs
# Total number of vocs used in diurnal model
nrow(diurn_on_50) # 6,712,067 #### 687,906
nrow(diurn_ev_50) # 5,030,446 #### 272,329
# Total number of presences used in nocturnal model
nrow(noc_50 |> filter(det == 1)) # 147,576
```

```{r}
#| label: unique-taxa
### Unique species
on_sp <- diurn_on_50 |> distinct(species_id)
ev_sp <- diurn_ev_50 |> distinct(species_id)
noc_50 |> distinct(species_id) |> count() # 24 nocturnal species
rbind(on_sp, ev_sp) |> distinct(species_id) |> count() # 465 diurnal species #### 441

### Unique families
on_fam <- diurn_on_50 |> distinct(family)
ev_fam <- diurn_ev_50 |> distinct(family)
noc_50 |> distinct(family) |> count() # 5 nocturnal families
rbind(on_fam, on_fam) |> distinct(family) |> count() # 63 diurnal families
```


```{r}
#| label: summary-vocs
### Mean/median vocs
diurn_on_50 |>
  group_by(family) |>
  summarize(vocs_fam = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarize(
    mean_vocs_fam = mean(vocs_fam),
    sd_vocs_fam = sd(vocs_fam),
    median_vocs_fam = median(vocs_fam)
  )

diurn_ev_50 |>
  group_by(family) |>
  summarize(vocs_fam = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarize(
    mean_vocs_fam = mean(vocs_fam),
    sd_vocs_fam = sd(vocs_fam),
    median_vocs_fam = median(vocs_fam)
  )

noc_50 |>
  filter(det == 1) |>
  group_by(species_id) |>
  summarize(vocs_sp = n()) |>
  ungroup() |>
  summarize(
    mean_vocs_sp = mean(vocs_sp),
    sd_vocs_sp = sd(vocs_sp),
    median_vocs_sp = median(vocs_sp)
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: unique-areas
### Grab continents/countries
pacman::p_load(sf, rnaturalearth)

on_coords <- diurn_on_50 |> distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)
ev_coords <- diurn_ev_50 |> distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)
noc_coords <- noc_50 |> distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)

all_coords <- rbind(on_coords, ev_coords, noc_coords) |>
  distinct(station_id, latitude, longitude)

coords_sf <- st_as_sf(
  all_coords,
  coords = c("longitude", "latitude"),
  crs = 4326
)
# Lay over a map of countries to extract # of countries
world <- ne_countries(scale = "medium", returnclass = "sf")

# Spatial join stations with country polygons
stations_with_geo <- st_join(coords_sf, world |> select(admin, continent))

# Count total countries and continents
geo_summary <- stations_with_geo |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarize(
    total_stations = n_distinct(station_id), # 5,266 stations #### 5,564
    total_countries = n_distinct(admin, na.rm = TRUE), # 56 countries ### 57
    total_continents = n_distinct(continent, na.rm = TRUE) # 6 continents
  )

print(geo_summary)
```
